preconditions.description: The length of the interview is a positive integer between 1 and 100, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: s consists of lowercase English letters
preconditions.description: The interview string s consists of lowercase English letters only.

postconditions.expression: s is modified to replace each filler word with '***'
postconditions.description: Each occurrence of the filler word 'ogo' or any of its extensions by adding 'go' multiple times is replaced with '***'.
